patterns.sample: From the top of a $60$ m tower, two cars on opposite sides are at depressions $30^\circ$ and $60^\circ$. Find the distance between them.

patterns.sample: From a ship's deck $10$ m above water, a hilltop is at elevation $60^\circ$ and its foot at depression $30^\circ$. Find the hill's height.

patterns.pattern: Moving object with depression or elevation change over time: find speed or remaining time

patterns.pattern: Flying object seen on opposite sides after a time: find its speed
patterns.sample: A plane at $1000$ m is seen at elevation $60^\circ$ and $20$ s later at $30^\circ$ on the other side of the observer. Find its speed.

patterns.pattern: Kite or bird seen by one ground observer and one rooftop observer
patterns.sample: A bird is seen at elevation $60^\circ$ along a $40$ m sightline from ground point $A$. An observer on a $10$ m roof on the other side sees it at $30^\circ$. Find the bird's distance from the roof observer.

patterns.pattern: Shadow grows as the Sun's altitude falls: find the height
patterns.sample: A tower's shadow is $40$ m longer when the Sun's altitude is $30^\circ$ than when it is $60^\circ$. Find the tower's height.

patterns.pattern: Reflection in a lake: elevation of an object and depression of its image

patterns.pattern: Case study: structure or balloon seen from two ground points
